responsibility: This header defines the main internal interface for GCC’s HSA subsystem. It declares the HSA IL classes and core data structures such as hsa_symbol, operands, instruction support types, function summaries, builtin helpers, and subsystem-global state, together with utility predicates, type/alignment helpers, compilation-unit lifecycle functions, kernel mapping APIs, BRIG emission entry points, dump hooks, and register-allocation hooks. It is the central shared declaration layer that connects hsa-gen.c, hsa-regalloc.c, hsa-brig.c, and hsa-dump.c around a common in-memory HSA representation.
same_name_distinction: Declares the shared HSA types, classes, globals, inline predicates, and cross-file APIs that tie together hsa-gen.c, hsa-regalloc.c, hsa-brig.c, hsa-dump.c, and hsa-common.c; unlike hsa-common.c, it does not own the common-state storage or implement the bookkeeping routines and method bodies.
